name: Notes
description: Markdown notes in projects, with checklists and autosave; edits on different devices merge. Notes saved from finished tasks live in the Tasks project.

create.description: Create a note: title (optional, defaults to the first line), body (Markdown), project, and focus (used as the project when none is given). Returns its id.

update.description: Change a note's title (blank follows the first line), body, project or pinned flag.

restore.description: Bring a note back from trash.

to_task.description: Create a To-do task from a line of text.

summary.description: Notes created or changed between local dates start and end.

tidy.description: Move a note to trash if it is empty.

task_note.description: Save what came of a finished task in its note in the Tasks project: key (the task, or its repeating series), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), text, tags. One note per key, newest entry first; replace (true when editing a saved note) swaps the entry with the same date. Returns its id.

focus_suggestions.sql: SELECT project AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' AND project <> 'Tasks' GROUP BY project ORDER BY count DESC, project LIMIT 30

list.sql: SELECT id, title, project, pinned, trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 160)) AS snippet, CASE WHEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?4 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?4, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday' WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?4, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?4, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS edited, CASE WHEN ((length(body) - length(replace(body, '- [x]', ''))) / 5) + ((length(body) - length(replace(body, '- [ ]', ''))) / 5) > 0 THEN ((length(body) - length(replace(body, '- [x]', ''))) / 5) || '/' || (((length(body) - length(replace(body, '- [x]', ''))) / 5) + ((length(body) - length(replace(body, '- [ ]', ''))) / 5)) END AS checklist, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes p WHERE p._deleted IS NULL AND p.pinned = 1) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN pinned = 1 THEN 'Pinned' ELSE 'Notes' END AS section FROM (SELECT * FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND ((COALESCE(?2, '') = '' AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks') OR project = ?2) ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 300) AS notes ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC

note.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN title = 'Untitled' OR title = trim(ltrim(trim(substr(body, 1, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) - 1)), '#')) THEN '' ELSE title END AS title, body, COALESCE(project, '') AS project, pinned FROM notes WHERE id = ?1 AND _deleted IS NULL

projects.sql: SELECT '' AS project, 'All' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '') AS selected FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks' UNION ALL SELECT project, project, COUNT(*), project = ?1 FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' GROUP BY project ORDER BY 1

pinned.sql: SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND pinned = 1 ORDER BY title LIMIT 8

trash.sql: SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NOT NULL AND NOT (title = 'Untitled' AND trim(COALESCE(body, '')) = '') ORDER BY _deleted DESC LIMIT 100

search.sql: SELECT id, title, COALESCE(project, trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 160))) AS subtitle FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 8

project_names.sql: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' ORDER BY project

recent.sql: SELECT id, title, pinned, trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 160)) AS snippet, project FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks' AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR project = ?1 COLLATE NOCASE OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2 COLLATE NOCASE) ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 5
